title: Execute a Controlled Splunk Upgrade Workflow
objectives: Execute a Controlled Splunk Upgrade Workflow
Verify actual source, version, service/data and retained recovery evidence.

tasks.instruction: The hf01 teaching package is staged. Create and verify a current configuration-only backup, then capture a valid hf01-only upgrade preflight. This is a standalone host exercise: peer/search-head upgrades require the bounded coordinator and tier prerequisites.

Acknowledge the nonbinding training flag and start the reviewed hf01 upgrade. The fixture clock is paused; advance five shared ticks, inspecting drain, stop, install, start and verification. Verify hf01 reports 9.4.2 through the virtual splunk version/status commands as well as the maintenance page. Original native configuration must remain unchanged.

Independently search index=source_logs | stats count and inspect the job; count=3. A staged filename, an unchanged 9.4.1 service or an incomplete job is insufficient. Abort retains actual package/service state; it is not a downgrade.

hints: Inspect the active native source and the original failure before changing anything.
Use the paused shared clock and an independent Search/Job Inspector check.

references.purpose: Controlled upgrade order, artifact verification and health prerequisites

checks.label: Completed hf01 package change with native configuration preserved
Verification search and Job Inspector retained

feedback.success: Actual maintenance outcomes, preserved data and independent verification meet this lesson.
feedback.incomplete: Review current source, version, activation history and independent evidence.
